question:
In radiocarbon dating, the activity of $^{14}\text{C}$ in a living organism is $A_0$. A sample taken from an ancient wood piece shows activity $A=0.30A_0$.

Given $T_{1/2}=5730\,\text{y}$ for $^{14}\text{C}$, estimate the age $t$ of the sample.

Use</br>
$$A=A_0 e^{-\lambda t},\quad \lambda=\frac{\ln2}{T_{1/2}},\quad t=\frac{1}{\lambda}\ln\left(\frac{A_0}{A}\right)$$
